# Medical Multi-Agent Co-Pilot

> A production-ready medical multi-agent system built with LangGraph, featuring intelligent symptom collection, department triage, specialized diagnosis, and decision fusion capabilities. --- ## English | [中文](#中文) ### Key Features - 🤖 **Intelligent Symptom Collection**: Multi-turn conversation to collect detailed symptom information - 🏥 **Smart Triage**: AI-powered department recommendation based on symptoms - 💓 **Specialized Diagnosis**: Dedicated agents for Cardiology, Respiratory, Gastroenterology, etc. - 🔄 **Decision Fusion**: Integrate multi-department recommendations for comprehensive diagnosis - 🧠 **Knowledge Reasoning**: Graph RAG-powered medical knowledge graph support - 📚 **Evidence-Based Validation**: CPubMed-KG2.0 integration for authoritative medical validation --- ### System Architecture

#### Multi-Agent Collaboration Architecture

#### Symptom Agent Workflow

#### Three-Layer Trust Mechanism

--- ### Tech Stack | Category | Technologies | |----------|--------------| | **Backend** | Python 3.10+, LangGraph, FastAPI | | **Frontend** | Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS | | **Database** | Graph RAG, CSV-based medical data | | **LLM** | OpenAI Compatible APIs (Qwen, GPT, etc.) | | **Testing** | pytest, pytest-asyncio | --- ### Quick Start #### Prerequisites - Python 3.10+ - Node.js 18+ - pnpm or npm #### 1. Clone the Repository ```bash git clone https://github.com/wzm110/Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot.git cd Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot ``` #### 2. Backend Setup ```bash cd app # Install dependencies uv install # or pip install -e . # Configure environment variables cp .env.example .env # Edit .env and fill in your API keys ``` Create `.env` file in `app/` directory: ```env # Language Model Configuration MODEL_NAME=your-model-name MODEL_PROVIDER=openai OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key OPENAI_API_BASE=https://your-api-base-url # LangSmith (optional, for tracing) LANGSMITH_PROJECT=your-project # Graph RAG (optional) GRAPH_RAG_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000/query GRAPH_RAG_API_KEY=your-api-key ``` #### 3. Frontend Setup ```bash cd agent-chat-ui # Install dependencies pnpm install # Configure environment variables cp .env.example .env # Edit .env with your backend URL ``` Create `.env` file in `agent-chat-ui/` directory: ```env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8123 NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSISTANT_ID=agent ``` #### 4. Start Services ```bash # Terminal 1: Start LangGraph Backend cd app langgraph serve # Terminal 2: Start Frontend cd agent-chat-ui pnpm dev ``` #### 5. Access - Frontend: http://localhost:3000 - LangGraph UI: http://localhost:8123/ui - API: http://localhost:8123 --- ### Project Structure ``` Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot/ ├── agent-chat-ui/ # Next.js Frontend │ ├── src/ │ │ ├── app/ # App router pages │ │ └── lib/ # Utilities │ ├── public/ # Static assets │ └── package.json ├── app/ # LangGraph Backend │ ├── src/agent/ │ │ ├── agents/ # Agent implementations │ │ ├── graph/ # Workflow definitions │ │ └── tools/ # Tool functions │ ├── tests/ # Test files │ └── pyproject.toml ├── data/ # Medical knowledge base │ └── medical data files ├── assets/ # Project assets ├── LICENSE └── README.md ``` --- ### Core Agents | Agent | Description | |-------|-------------| | Symptom Agent | Collects patient symptoms through conversation | | Triage Agent | Recommends appropriate departments | | Cardiology Agent | Cardiovascular system diagnosis | | Respiratory Agent | Respiratory system diagnosis | | Gastroenterology Agent | Digestive system diagnosis | | Fusion Agent | Integrates all recommendations | --- ### Testing ```bash # Backend tests cd app python -m pytest tests/ -v # Lint ruff check . mypy ``` --- ### Contributing Contributions are welcome! Please feel free to submit a Pull Request. 1. Fork the repository 2. Create your feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`) 3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add some amazing feature'`) 4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`) 5. Open a Pull Request --- ### License This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the [LICENSE](LICENSE) file for details. --- ### Disclaimer > ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**: This system is for research and educational purposes only. The diagnostic suggestions provided are preliminary references only and cannot replace professional medical diagnosis. > > In case of medical emergencies, please immediately call your local emergency number or seek medical attention at a hospital. --- ## 中文 基于 LangGraph 构建的生产级医学多智能体系统，具备智能症状采集、科室分诊、专科诊断和决策融合能力。 ### 主要功能 - 🤖 **智能症状采集**：通过多轮对话收集详细症状信息 - 🏥 **智能分诊**：根据症状推荐就诊科室 - 💓 **专科诊断**：心血管内科、呼吸内科、消化内科等专科智能体 - 🔄 **决策融合**：整合多科室建议，提供综合诊断 - 🧠 **知识推理**：Graph RAG 医学知识图谱支持 - 📚 **循证验证**：集成 CPubMed-KG2.0 医学知识图谱 --- ### 系统架构

--- ### 技术栈 | 类别 | 技术 | |------|------| | **后端** | Python 3.10+, LangGraph, FastAPI | | **前端** | Next.js 14, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS | | **数据库** | Graph RAG, CSV 医学数据 | | **大语言模型** | OpenAI 兼容 API (通义千问, GPT 等) | | **测试** | pytest, pytest-asyncio | --- ### 快速开始 #### 前置要求 - Python 3.10+ - Node.js 18+ - pnpm 或 npm #### 1. 克隆项目 ```bash git clone https://github.com/wzm110/Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot.git cd Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot ``` #### 2. 后端配置 ```bash cd app # 安装依赖 uv install # 或 pip install -e . # 配置环境变量 cp .env.example .env # 编辑 .env 填写您的 API 密钥 ``` 在 `app/` 目录创建 `.env` 文件： ```env # 语言模型配置 MODEL_NAME=your-model-name MODEL_PROVIDER=openai OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key OPENAI_API_BASE=https://your-api-base-url # LangSmith（可选，用于追踪） LANGSMITH_PROJECT=your-project # Graph RAG（可选） GRAPH_RAG_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000/query GRAPH_RAG_API_KEY=your-api-key ``` #### 3. 前端配置 ```bash cd agent-chat-ui # 安装依赖 pnpm install # 配置环境变量 cp .env.example .env # 编辑 .env 填写后端地址 ``` 在 `agent-chat-ui/` 目录创建 `.env` 文件： ```env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8123 NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSISTANT_ID=agent ``` #### 4. 启动服务 ```bash # 终端 1: 启动 LangGraph 后端 cd app langgraph serve # 终端 2: 启动前端 cd agent-chat-ui pnpm dev ``` #### 5. 访问 - 前端界面: http://localhost:3000 - LangGraph UI: http://localhost:8123/ui - API: http://localhost:8123 --- ### 项目结构 ``` Medical-Multi-Agent-Co-Pilot/ ├── agent-chat-ui/ # Next.js 前端 │ ├── src/ │ │ ├── app/ # 页面路由 │ │ └── lib/ # 工具函数 │ ├── public/ # 静态资源 │ └── package.json ├── app/ # LangGraph 后端 │ ├── src/agent/ │ │ ├── agents/ # 智能体实现 │ │ ├── graph/ # 工作流定义 │ │ └── tools/ # 工具函数 │ ├── tests/ # 测试文件 │ └── pyproject.toml ├── data/ # 医学知识库 │ └── 医学数据文件 ├── assets/ # 项目资源 ├── LICENSE └── README.md ``` --- ### 核心智能体 | 智能体 | 功能描述 | |--------|----------| | 症状采集智能体 | 通过对话收集患者症状 | | 分诊调度智能体 | 推荐就诊科室 | | 心血管内科智能体 | 心血管系统诊断 | | 呼吸内科智能体 | 呼吸系统诊断 | | 消化内科智能体 | 消化系统诊断 | | 决策融合智能体 | 整合所有建议 | --- ### 测试 ```bash # 后端测试 cd app python -m pytest tests/ -v # 代码检查 ruff check . mypy ``` --- ### 贡献 欢迎贡献！请提交 Pull Request。 1. Fork 本仓库 2. 创建特性分支 (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`) 3. 提交更改 (`git commit -m 'Add some amazing feature'`) 4. 推送分支 (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`) 5. 打开 Pull Request --- ### 许可证 本项目基于 MIT 许可证 - 查看 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 文件了解更多详情。 --- ### 免责声明 > ⚠️ **重要提示**：本系统仅用于研究和教育目的。提供的诊断建议仅供参考，不能替代专业医疗诊断。 > > 如遇紧急医疗情况，请立即拨打当地急救电话或前往医院就诊。 ---
